provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production-ready far-depth lower-foundation parallax layer for a side-view 2D exploration platformer
Primary request: Create exactly one connected ancient catacomb gallery foundation formation. Show broad crypt foundations, small recessed burial niches, eroded retaining walls, shallow rubble terraces, and dense dark masonry masses. This is a far-depth lower-foundation companion designed to overlap neighboring copies by 96 target pixels.
Canvas and output: one PNG image, target composition aspect ratio exactly 960:540 (16:9). Fill the full canvas with the removal matte wherever there is no masonry.
Background/removal matte: use one perfectly flat, uniform, fully opaque chroma matte color #FF00FF, RGBA (255, 0, 255, 255), for EVERY background pixel. No gradients, texture, noise, shadows, color variation, or stray marks in matte areas. Do not use transparency or any substitute chroma color.
Subject/composition: The connected formation spans nearly the full canvas height. Its irregular upper masonry contour begins within the top 4% of the canvas, and its dense foundation ends within the bottom 4%, so there are no large empty matte bands above or below. Keep the architecture broad, weighty, horizontally layered, and foundation-like, never tower-like. Reserve the outermost 7% of canvas width on both left and right as completely empty uniform #FF00FF matte gutters. Taper the masonry into irregular rubble just before each gutter. Absolutely no subject pixel may enter either gutter or touch either lateral image edge. The two clean solid-magenta edge gutters must match perfectly so copies can overlap them by 96 target pixels; horizontal repetition is seamless through these matching gutters, not through a wall cut at the boundary. Keep all masonry as one visually connected formation; no detached objects.
Style/medium: crisp hand-authored 16-bit pixel art, deliberate chunky pixel clusters, hard pixel edges, sharp blocky silhouette, no antialiasing, no smoothing, no painterly effects. Broad strong silhouettes and clearly separated value groups for readable gameplay.
Palette: masonry only in dark navy and indigo stone, desaturated blue-purple midtones, and restrained pale blue highlights. The only non-masonry color is the exact #FF00FF matte.
Lighting/mood: cold subtle subterranean light from upper left; dark, ancient, monumental, quiet.
Architecture: wide low burial recesses and broken rectangular niches rather than tall arches; heavy horizontal courses and terraces; erosion and rubble kept chunky and readable; dense lower masonry.
Constraints: exactly one formation and exactly one image. No text, lettering, UI, border, picture frame, signature, or watermark.
Avoid: tall arches, full-height columns, towers, spires, ceiling structures, repeated skull emblems, second skyline, characters, creatures, props, floor plane, platforms intended for gameplay, detached stones or objects, visible subject pixels in either lateral gutter, any pixel touching left or right edge, solid wall cutoffs at the canvas boundary, large unused top or bottom bands, painterly blur, glow bleed into matte, soft edges, smoothing, antialiasing, translucent pixels, shadows cast onto matte, matte contamination, magenta within the masonry.
